funeral.line: To go and watch a funeral?
stanza: Look, I didn't want to have to tell you
But I may be coming down with hepatitis
And I think I'm gonna faint
So if you wanna see me faint
I'll do it happily
But wouldn't it be funnier
To go and watch a funeral?
So thank you for the
Twenty-seven dinner plates
Thirty-seven butter knives
Forty-seven paperweights
Fifty-seven candle holders—

funeral.line: Couldn't see his used up body at the funeral
stanza: Couldn't see his used up body at the funeral
By virtue of the flailing of his conquests
They tied down his casket with a garter belt
Each troubled heart was beating in a sequined dress
Someone must console these lonesome daughters
No written word or ballad will appease them
The cowboy and the cop shot down the Ladies' Man
The humid nights in LA are now silent
I swear that man was womankind's first husband
